## Checklist

- [ ] I have the right to submit this code under the MIT licence. Anything copied or adapted from
      elsewhere is named above, with its source and its licence.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass on my branch.
- [ ] A behaviour change comes with its test.
- [ ] Every test document I add is built by a generator kept in the repository, or is under an
      open licence written in the `SOURCES.md` of its folder. None is a personal or company
      document.
- [ ] No name of a person in the code, the comments, the tests or the file names.

Every outside pull request is accepted or refused by the maintainer in person.
